sources.locator: Title block SS-12D01-GXXX; Switch Height G020 row; dimensions and PCB LAYOUT BOTTOM VIEW figures; SCHEMATIC NON-SHORTING figure; G-Switch Specification table
sources.evidence_extract: Manufacturer-authored family drawing at distributor mirror: G020 selects 2.0 mm actuator projection above 3.5 mm body, nominal 5.5 mm total height at seating plane; body 8.8 x 3.9 mm, 2 mm travel, 2.5 mm terminal pitch, three terminals and non-shorting SPDT circuit with center common. Manufacturer does not print terminal numbers; project assigns center 2 and outer 1/3. Electrical rating 1.0 A at 24 VDC, contact resistance <=50 milliohm, insulation >=100 megohm at 250 VDC, electrical life 10,000 cycles, operating -25 to +70 C. Exact G020 supplier identity is separately confirmed; mirror authority does not close manufacturer-primary trust.
